notes.title: Version 0.7.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325179/8444eb3c8613f14f1b9b287f87776cf9e6798e29.png

Fast-forward functionality added!
Tired of seeing the same animation for the 5th time in a row? You can now fast forward through the execution of a command.

Other changes

 Fixed some typos in hints & dialog
 Improve the unlock condition for multiple milestones & achievements to allow indirect actions
 Fix tooltips being cropped on high resolution screens

notes.title: Version 0.6.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325179/ba292aa231842d70a88af0c993fa93df59ee91b1.png

The hint system is now live!
Need a hint to find any of the 13 ways to kill Alice available in the demo? Three gradual hints are available per milestone, to guide you to the solution without giving it outright.
